## The claim

The merged report's narrative, synthesised in mode claude-code from the merged rows (lanes, agreement matrix, both fusions, disagreement count, and each lane's own section 6), cites every sentence to a row that was sent and names no lane, gene or disease the rows never gave it.

**Prediction if true.** mva-zoo narrate --merged --mode claude-code: mva.zoo.narrate_check against mva.zoo.narrate_rows.merged_rows reports uncited_sentences / sentences at most 0.10, unknown_ids empty and new_names empty.

**What would refute it.** The synthesis leaves more than 10 percent of its sentences without a citation that resolves to a merged row, cites an id that was never sent, or names a lane, gene or disease outside the rows.
